items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: So then Milt turned around and got Perry Bradford by his house and he told the same story the same way.

ctx.x: Yeah. He says, 'You know, this guy never paid me my money back.' Wasn't but $1.46. So now this all ties in with Milt Hinton. So Milt had -- they were coming to my house in Long Island, so Milt said, 'Well, bring him by my house.' I said okay. We all went by there and Milt's wife Mona, they were cooking and making a barbecue, and the way Eubie told it, well as you know, he's a great comedian anyway. He had everybody in stitches, just the way he just told it, you know, the way he told the story. So then Milt turned…
